rationale: The complete153-mask fixed-budget offline screen selected [2,13] versus [7,14]. Object/Spatial error preferences are a heuristic; new closed-loop outcomes must establish whether preferences transfer to success.

fixed_science.residual_compensation: Unused with empty VLM masks; established own-Full timestamps and receipts retained.
fixed_science.sampler: Unmodified Pi0Adapter.sample, native eager arithmetic; observed helper dispatch bypasses two AE layers only on FastD2

calibration.requirement: Native no-bypassD2/D10 raw/decoded parity1e-5; actual ordered layer visits/NFE and full prefix, period/reset; all eight known Full/AE16 controls bitwise reproduce their two original roots.
calibration.fixed_cost: All four definitions on each service, four fixed suite inputs,6 warmups plus12 measured requests; whole three-request native policy cycles.

discovery.qualification: Both new paths overall>=.75 and>=Full-.15, each completed-service median native fixed-input cost ratio>=1.15, pair costs within10%; both fixed proxy directions gap>=10pp,>=2 positive tasks, every task LOO positive.
discovery.direction_selection: Exactly path_a>path_b onObject and path_b>path_a onSpatial. No suite/path reselection, no promotion of another screened mask, and no use of known AE16 benchmark as a selectable alternative.

confirmation.primary: One-sided exact ten-task signflip including ties; Holm2 for exactly the two fixed directions.
confirmation.bootstrap_arithmetic: Integer paired/task difference sums before division; linear percentile quantiles.
confirmation.success: Both differences positive, both task-signflip Holm2p<.05, both whole-task-bootstrap lower bounds>0 and all task LOO positive. Both paths also pass the same quality/native-cost gates.

independence: init45–46 and original Full/AE16 controls are known discovery cases, not new controls or confirmation. Offline observations use historical initial/phase inputs and are not heldout quality results.
no_candidate: Preserve all valid outcomes, keep confirmation locked, do not lower gates; continue the overall goal with a new bounded branch if warranted.
limits: Suite-conditioned fixed paths only; no online phase-selection, runtime-routing gain, universal category inference, exclusive-GPU speed, or study-wide5% family-error claim.
